rv.q: It is a story to be experienced and savored.
The production is simple–befitting the small space–but elegant and carrying its own witchy magic.
But much of the dialogue doesn’t sound the way people actually speak to one another, and the story of the two lovers doesn’t so much unfold as occasionally pop up.
What gives Shakey Jake its potency and unusual charm is the poetic way the playwright infuses his comfortably familiar story with magical realism.
